dataset_note: Curated OECD tax soft-law. HTML pages on oecd.org are often Cloudflare-blocked; free PDFs under /content/dam/ (and some /tax/beps/) are the retrieval path. Not SDMX statistics. Soft law — classify as organisation guideline/standard, not binding treaty law unless a given instrument says otherwise. Cite title, year, paragraph/article. Catalogue URLs verified HTTP 200 on 2026-09-27.
